text:
maya: quick ask — can someone capture an nsys + torch.profiler combo for a short 'slab' smoke run?
We saw a ~2x 99th latency spike on dedicated-pool-3 when KV cache is cold. Need a minimal capture (5 iters) that reproduces the tail behavior.

aj: can do. which model + batch shape + prompt? and do you want full python stack traces or just nvtx/cuda kernels?

maya: model: redwood/opt-6b (latest pinned). batch=1 seq=1024 sample prompt: `repeat: 512 tokens of "x"` — it's deterministic. please collect: nsys with --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt and torch.profiler with record_shapes + stacktrace.

kevin: I can run on pool-3 after hours. drop the exact commands you want and an env var list. will scrub logs before upload.

maya: command I usually use:
```bash
# assume conda env with pytorch + nsight installed
export PERF_BUCKET=s3://redwood-profiling/ingress/maya/slab-smoke
nsys profile -o /tmp/slab_smoke --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --sample=none python -u run_infer.py --model redwood/opt-6b --seq 1024 --iters 5
# torch.profiler inside run_infer.py
# with: torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True, with_stack=True, profile_memory=True)
```

aj: perfect. two small notes: 1) add `--warmup 1 --no_grad_cache` so we capture cold->warm transition, 2) set `TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128` to avoid fragmentation noise.

kevin: got it. will run with those flags and the env. ETA ~45m to capture and upload. tagging sasha for redaction checklist.

sasha: thanks — scrub checklist: remove any customer prompt data, redact user ids, strip full path kernel symbols that contain home dirs. upload path should be `s3://redwood-profiling/ingress/eng-runtime/2654321000/` and add a README with capture flags. Perf-bot will generate a presigned link.

perf-bot: artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-profiling/ingress/eng-runtime/2654321000/slab_smoke.nsys.tar.gz — presigned link: https://presigned.example/2654321000/slab_smoke.nsys.tar.gz (expires in 72h) :white_check_mark:

aj: grabbing now. I'll generate flamegraphs + combined torchprof timeline and post quick diffs. expected delivery ~2h.

maya: amazing, thank you all. if flamegraph shows big kernel time in softmax matmul, flagging runtime team for kernel-tune follow-up.

kevin: leaving logs and a short repro README in the bucket. ping me if you need a live run. :thumbsup:
